product_overview: SaaS Chatbot Inteligente Twilio is a platform enabling businesses to manage companies, subscriptions, payments, and customer interactions via an intelligent chatbot integrated with WhatsApp using Twilio. It streamlines communication and operational management to enhance customer support and business efficiency.
core_goals: Provide a seamless and secure user authentication and profile management system.
Enable management of multiple companies with multi-user access.
Offer diverse subscription plans with scalable feature access and easy upgrade/downgrade.
Integrate payment processing with supported gateways ensuring reliable transaction handling.
Deliver a dynamic dashboard that provides insightful metrics and usage reports aligned with subscription plans.
Facilitate intelligent WhatsApp chatbot communication for effective customer engagement.
Ensure robust routing and access control mechanisms to prevent bugs and improve user navigation experience.
key_features: Complete authentication system with JWT including user registration, login, and profile management.
Multi-company management capabilities supporting creation, viewing, and editing by authorized users.
Subscription management system with multiple plans, subscription statuses, and change plans functionality.
Payment gateway integration primarily with PayPal for payment processing and transaction history viewing.
Dashboard analytics featuring real-time metrics, charts, and usage reports limited by user subscription.
WhatsApp integration using Twilio API to send and receive messages with an AI-driven chatbot powered by Google Gemini AI.
Feature guards restricting functionalities based on user subscription plans ensuring access control.
Error handling for routing including 404 pages for invalid routes and graceful redirection post login or registration.
Health monitoring and Redis caching to optimize application performance and reliability.
Admin panel for user management and configuration settings.
user_flow_summary: User registers or logs into the platform using the authentication system.
Authenticated user creates or selects a company to manage within their account.
User selects a subscription plan or views current subscription status; upgrades or downgrades as needed.
User makes payments via integrated PayPal system and reviews payment history.
User accesses dashboard showing metrics, charts, and chatbot usage reports constrained by their subscription plan.
User interacts with customers through an intelligent WhatsApp chatbot with automated responses.
Application manages route access by authenticating users and authorizing based on permissions and subscription level.
Users encounter appropriate screen redirects (e.g., to login if unauthenticated, or 404 page if the route is invalid).
validation_criteria: All user authentication flows must function smoothly with JWT and proper session management.
Users must be able to create, view, and edit companies without errors.
Subscription changes must update user access and reflect accurately in the system.
Payment processing via PayPal should complete transactions reliably and update payment history correctly.
Dashboard metrics and reports should load correctly aligned with subscription privileges.
WhatsApp chatbot must reliably send, receive, and auto-respond to messages using Twilio and AI services.
Routing should be consistent, with correct redirection for unauthorized access and invalid URLs displaying 404 pages.
All feature access restrictions based on plans must be enforced without bypass.
The system should handle routing bugs gracefully and improve navigation fluidity.
Health monitoring and caching should maintain performance stability throughout use.
